description: Canonical path boundary of the reqQuest Framework toolkit. The GitHub Release asset `raac-toolkit-<version>.tar.gz` attached to every `toolkit-v<version>` tag contains exactly the files matched by `boundary` or `seed` and not by `exclude`, packed under a single top-level `raac-toolkit-<version>/` directory. `.reqq/validator/reqq_validate.py` reads this same file to compute the hashes it records in `.reqq/toolkit.lock`. The boundary must stay self-sufficient: whatever the shipped validator and the shipped CI workflow need in order to run green on a fresh extract has to be inside it, except the libraries listed in `.reqq/validator/requirements.txt`, which the shipped workflow installs with pip. `seed` lists starting templates the adopter owns from the first install on: they ship in the asset, but are never hashed into `.reqq/toolkit.lock` and `upgrade` never adds, replaces or removes them. A path may not match both `boundary` and `seed`. `public` defines what the internal repository of the framework publishes to the public repository; it has no meaning for adopters.
